findings.source_passage: Already has it been related how the great leviathan is afar off descried from the mast-head; how he is chased over the watery moors, and slaughtered in the valleys of the deep
findings.why_it_matters: The grand anaphoric opening catalogue ('how he is … how he is … how …') is Melville's rhetorical set-piece establishing the epic register of the whole chapter; the draft drops it entirely and begins mid-sequence, losing the voice-defining periodic sentence.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the anaphoric opening ('Already has it been related how … how … how …') either in full or in compressed form that preserves the rhetorical figure before transitioning to the romantic proceeding.

findings.source_passage: One day the planks stream with freshets of blood and oil; on the sacred quarter-deck enormous masses of the whale's head are profanely piled
findings.why_it_matters: The source has 'freshets of blood and oil' and 'the sacred quarter-deck' — the word 'sacred' creates an ironic tension central to the passage's meaning; the draft omits 'freshets' and 'sacred,' flattening the irony.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'freshets of blood and oil' and 'on the sacred quarter-deck' to preserve Melville's ironic register contrast between the holy and the profane.

findings.source_passage: the mariners go about suffused with unctuousness; the entire ship seems great leviathan himself
findings.why_it_matters: The draft renders this as 'the mariners go unctuous; the entire ship seems leviathan'—losing 'suffused with unctuousness' and 'great leviathan himself,' which carry the comic-grotesque texture of the original.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'suffused with unctuousness' and 'great leviathan himself' to preserve the mock-heroic register.

findings.source_passage: and whenever any adhesiveness from the back of the whale remains clinging to the side, that lye quickly exterminates it
findings.source_locator: Paragraph beginning 'But a day or two after'
findings.why_it_matters: This detail of the lye's action is part of the precisely observed industrial process Melville renders with comic precision; its omission thins the texture of the cleaning sequence.
findings.suggested_fix: Minor: add the lye-exterminates-adhesiveness detail within the cleaning paragraph.

summary: The draft preserves all high-priority signatures intact—the metempsychosis peroration, the Pythagoras apostrophe, the 'man-killing' climax, the bridegroom simile, and the 'there she blows' refrain—but flattens the anaphoric opening and softens two ironic phrases in the contrast-passage; no finding rises to high severity, and the total medium findings are below the regeneration threshold.
